operations.name: Suggest options from a website
operations.agentTask: Read the website in `sourceUrl` and write three different ways to fill the ad "A capability sequence on connected paths". Objective: Explain an onboarding or service journey in a compact diagram. Visual rule: A continuous visual path communicates progression; one node is active at a time. Beats, in order: - 0–1.8 s: First node and the desired outcome appear together. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Outcome. - 1.8–4.2 s: Path connects the first and second nodes. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Line 1. - 4.2–6.6 s: Next node becomes active. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Line 2. - 6.6–9 s: Final node completes the journey. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Stage icon 4, Line 3. - 9–12 s: Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step. Shows Brand color, Stage icon 1, Stage icon 2, Stage icon 3, Stage icon 4, Logo, Outcome and call to action. Use only facts the website or pages you read state. Never invent prices, discounts, dates, guarantees or claims. When a fact a field needs is missing, write a short placeholder in square brackets, such as [offer end date]. Make the three options clearly different in angle, wording and image choice. For images, choose real, large images of this brand and product: first from the page's own images (header logo, large files, feature-page screenshots), then with an image search. A social preview card (og:image, a title on a gradient) is a last resort. Give the direct URL of the image file, never a page URL, and never an image of another brand. Use an empty string when no image fits. If image search throws because no search backend is configured, tell the user in one sentence that a SerpAPI, DataForSEO or Brave key in Settings finds better images. Then take nodetool.web.screenshot of the product's feature pages instead. Save each image you consider as an asset and look at it with view_image before you offer it. Name in the option's description any image that is only a social preview card. Write `fillOptions` as a list of three objects, `fillChoice` as "" and `fillReport` as "". Each option: - value: "1", "2" or "3" - title: a name for the direction in 2 to 4 words - description: one sentence on what it emphasizes, then the first two copy lines in quotes - image: the URL of its first image, for the option card - brandColor: the brand's accent color as #RRGGBB (buttons, links, highlights), not the page background or a theme-color that is near black or white - fields: outcomeHook (Outcome: hook, at most 7 words); stage1 (Line 1: stage 1, at most 7 words); stage2 (Line 2: stage 2, at most 7 words); stage3 (Line 3: stage 3, at most 7 words); outcomeAndCta (Outcome and call to action: outcome and cta, at most 8 words) - images: stageIcon1 (Stage icon 1: An icon or mark on a plain or transparent background. It shows small, as a node or tile, so it must read at about 200 px wide. Not a screenshot or a social preview card. Shown in: First node and the desired outcome appear together. | Path connects the first and second nodes. | Next node becomes active. | Final node completes the journey. | Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.); stageIcon2 (Stage icon 2: An icon or mark on a plain or transparent background. It shows small, as a node or tile, so it must read at about 200 px wide. Not a screenshot or a social preview card. Shown in: Path connects the first and second nodes. | Next node becomes active. | Final node completes the journey. | Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.); stageIcon3 (Stage icon 3: An icon or mark on a plain or transparent background. It shows small, as a node or tile, so it must read at about 200 px wide. Not a screenshot or a social preview card. Shown in: Next node becomes active. | Final node completes the journey. | Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.); stageIcon4 (Stage icon 4: An icon or mark on a plain or transparent background. It shows small, as a node or tile, so it must read at about 200 px wide. Not a screenshot or a social preview card. Shown in: Final node completes the journey. | Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.); logo (Logo: The brand's own logo file, such as the site header logo or its icon. Shown in: Entire journey is visible with a concrete next step.) Then show the Start step with `only: ["fillChoice"]` and a one-sentence note, so the user sees just the option cards. Picking one runs `apply`, which saves the images and fills the steps.
